items.title: Deadline to cancel appointment without penalty
items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: Appointment is Monday 14.12.2026. 'Werktage' = Mon-Sat excluding holidays. Counting backward from the appointment day (not counted itself): Sunday 13.12. is not a Werktag (skipped), Saturday 12.12. = 1st Werktag before, Friday 11.12. = 2nd Werktag before. No public holidays fall in this window (NRW or HE, where the practice sits). So the latest day to cancel while still giving the required two Werktage notice is Friday 11.12.2026.
